apps.message:
fix(publish): catch up on every copy that differs from what is served

## Intent

Six update pull requests merged in a row left four copies at their old version. The publish runs waiting in between were cancelled, and the last one built only what its own push changed. Every run must bring all copies up to date.

## Key changes

- The publish plan compares the entries with the served start/copies.txt and builds every app whose copy is missing or at another commit.
- The plan records the bug and its side effect: an entry whose copy never builds is retried on every push, and the run stays red until it is fixed or delisted.
